text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Dirt or turf... For now, I can still just ride
out my
luck. But...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I'll have to make a choice eventually. I
wonder
how everyone else decided. Did
they just choose
based on their
aptitude?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! In times like these, the best
thing to do
is ask directly! ☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh? Why do the two of us run on turf?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, we know exactly why! Don't we,
Dia?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We promised we'd run in the Classic
Triple Crown
and the Arima Kinen
together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We sure did. And on top of that...
winning one of
the classics is my whole
life's purpose.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see... A promise between friends and a
"whole
life's purpose." It makes sense
you'd pick turf,
then.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (Okay, now for part two—I need to ask other racers why they run on dirt...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I need to ask why they decided on a

specialization that doesn't get as much
of the
spotlight. And the person I want
to ask the most
is...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What? Why do I run on dirt?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. What made you decide to be a
dirt racer?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, it's because I run best on dirt.

Although, honestly, there is another
reason...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I thought running on dirt would be the
best way
to promote Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: How would it promote your hometown?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I come from one of the greatest port
cities in all
of northern Japan. But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's not as famous as Sapporo or
Hakodate, right?
It's like it supports
Hokkaido from behind the
scenes.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's something about dirt races that
reminds
me of that reliable, hardworking
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't stand out now, if I keep
doing my
best, someday people will
notice and I can be
famous!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's what made me choose dirt races.
They
represent the way I live my life!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Dirt's how you live your life, huh...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So you chose it based on your aptitude
and how
you feel it relates back to your
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Dirt represents my desire to really
cherish
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think I get it. So if I consider my
aptitude and
feelings...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I should be thinking about
what I need
to do to spread feng shui
and help people.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ngh. Rickey... Feng shui again? Really?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This is real talk, you know? You should
forget
about feng shui while you figure
this stuff out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The decision you make now could influence your whole future, Rickey. What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're still figuring it out. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But that's totally normal. ♪ Deciding
whether to
go with dirt or turf races is a
huge deal.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh! Falco!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Falco, also known as Smart Falcon...
She's an
older racer who's done amazing
things on the
dirt.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(She's also an Umamusume idol—or

"Umadol"—and Tarumae really looks up
to her.)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I had a pretty
tough
time choosing too. I was like,
"Turf? Dirt? Which
one's better?" ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Turf really is the shining star of the
Japanese
racing world, and I was stuck
on that for ages.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um! Then what made you choose dirt in
the end?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'm really interested to know how you decided!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, part of it was definitely
that I run
better on dirt, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think it was my dream that gave me the
final
push.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Your dream?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! My dream is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: To be the top Umadol! I want to stand right on center stage and shine the brightest!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Racers who can shine with all their might
while
covered in dirt are just as precious
as turf runners.
And I want to make my
dream come true on that
same dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I went with dirt! You know, I
think your
dream might be what really
matters.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My dream, huh... My aptitude... and my
dream...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Falco. You put all my
thoughts
into such nice words.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I hope I helped a bit. Give it a
think,
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened, Trainer. And it
made me
think...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I should probably get my ducks in a row
before I
take on my next goal race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's dream sounds simple
enough,
but she's right—it would be
good for her to
organize her ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My dream, or in other words, my
ultimate goal, is
to make everyone
happy through feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In the same way Falco can shine on the
dirt track,
I can convey the power of
feng shui here. No, in
fact...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It would be easier to convey its power on the dirt. So even though it'll take time, I think it'd be better to use the dirt to help the ideas really sink in.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That should work... That way will
bring me
closer to my dream. But still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm missing something
important. Like
there's some place the
dragon veins aren't
connecting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our talk, I can see that while
Copano Rickey
has the general idea
pinned down, she's still not
fully
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Something's holding me back.
But what?
There has to be a key
somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking will only get us so far...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good point... The whole reason I
decided to
run in an open dirt race was
to help me decide.
choice_data_list: それを見極めるための『伏竜S』だろ？
それを見極めるための『伏竜S』だよね？
choice_data_list_en: The Fukuryu Stakes is meant to test that, isn't it?
The Fukuryu Stakes is meant to test that, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer. I guess I was
overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, so my dream is what matters. I
know that
much! Next up...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to try asking Fukuryu! I wonder
what
answers I'll get from the dragon
lurking in the
dirt?
